name: Taking in requests from anywhere
vision_statement: A person or a program reaches the runner from wherever they work, by a message, a terminal, a live channel or the package itself, and is understood the same way.
opportunities: A runner is reached from many places and each has its own failure and cost, which the parent solution measures one by one and none together: a short chat message must not pay for a long run, an image has to be described before it can ground an answer, input that arrives while a run works must be heard at the next decision, a terminal session needs helper calls that cost a fraction of a cent, and a developer needs a package that installs and runs on an empty environment, learned from documents and examples that are kept true.
solution_coherence: Request intake lets a person or a program reach the runner from wherever they work and be understood the same way, and ways_in is its arm. Cost-aware message router matches each message to the handling it needs, from a direct answer to a long run. Image description for grounding turns an image the person attached into text that can ground the answer. Incremental context-update feed brings what changed in a work item since the last turn. Conversation-keyed mid-run input inbox lets a person change direction or stop a run that is already working. Non-interactive command-line surface runs the tools from the command line with predictable output and exit codes. Terminal helper calls makes the small model calls a terminal session needs. Public package surface contract gives a program a stable package to import and configure. It hands over load_config, the front door that builds the lane's one configuration through Layered lane configuration loader. Documentation coverage and voice check documents the package through Public package surface contract so that a newcomer can learn it from complete documents. Runnable example set shows how to use the package through Public package surface contract in small examples that run on an empty environment. Layered lane configuration loader gives whoever runs a lane one configuration, built from its file and its environment in a fixed order, so every lane is set up the same way. It turns each selection the file or the environment names into the arm that runs through Implementation selection.
